File_Description: Step-by-step instructions used to complete the sampling in the field.

Metadata for each set of samples collected at a given point in space and time. Each row generally refers to a set of many vials collected for different analysis and often includes five replicates per analysis per treatment that are each named with the same sample name and each have a replicate identifier appended to the end to create a unique identifier (e.g. EV_005 provides information for all samples that start with EV_005). The metadata file provides accompanying information captured in the field (i.e. coordinates; date; weather; etc.).

File_Description: Plots for each sample of data points included in the respiration rates. The plots include raw data points, a linear fit as shown by blue line, R2, p-value, and slope in milligrams per liter per minute. The data points are reported in "WHONDRS_EV_Sediment_Respiration_Raw_Dissolved_Oxygen.csv". The linear fit is used to calculate the respiration rates reported in "WHONDRS_EV_Sediment_SpC_pH_Temp_Respiration.csv". Each page consists of four plots per sample: no points removed, cleaned, break point removed, and final. These are defined as follows: (1) "No Points Removed" means the plot shows the original data set, (2) "Cleaned" means the plot shows the low data points as per set threshold were removed,  the 2 minute time point if the sample was put on the rollers the same minute a picture was taken was removed, and theoretical point is removed if not needed, (3) "Break Point Removed" means the plot shows the linear fit following break point segmentation regression, if applicable, and (4) "Final" means the plots shows the final linear fit between elapsed time and dissolved oxygen after cleaning, break point segmentation regression, and Breusch-Pagan test for heteroscedasticity.

Time series dissolved oxygen data used to calculate respiration rates. Methods information is embedded with methods codes that are defined in WHONDRS_EV_Methods_Codes.csv. File_Description: Mean/median/standard deviation of specific conductance;  pH;  temperature;  respiration;  initial/final gravimetric moisture; and  iron (II); from sediment samples. Methods information is embedded with methods codes that are defined in WHONDRS_EV_Methods_Codes.csv. The file follows the Environmental System Science Data Infrastructure for a Virtual Ecosystem (ESS-DIVE) Reporting Format for Water; Soil; and Sediment Chemistry data (Boye et al. 2022). This file provides the mean/median/standard deviation value of the specified data type for each sampling event and treatment (e.g. EV_005-W or EV_005-D). The "Median_Missing_Reps" and "Mean_Missing_Reps" column indicates if a median or mean does not include all replicates using a TRUE/FALSE flag where TRUE indicates one or more replicates are missing from the median or mean.
Standard: ESS-DIVE Water-Soil-Sediment Chem v1; ESS-DIVE CSV v1

Methods information is embedded with methods codes that are defined in WHONDRS_EV_Methods_Codes.csv.
